question:
The Secretariat of the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC) was set up at _______ in 1987.

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Kathmandu
New Delhi
Islamabad
Dhaka
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Kathmandu

Explanation:
The Secretariat of the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC) was established in Kathmandu, Nepal in 1987. SAARC was founded on 8 December 1985, and the decision to locate its headquarters in Kathmandu was made by its founding member states. The Secretariat is responsible for the daily operations of the organization and promoting regional cooperation. Kathmandu was chosen as it is a central and neutral location in South Asia, accessible to all member countries.

Extra Facts:
SAARC currently has 8 member countries: India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Maldives, and Afghanistan. Its primary objective is to promote economic, social, and cultural development in South Asia. SAARC has also launched key initiatives like the South Asian Free Trade Area (SAFTA).

Important Points:
☛ SAARC - 1985 (8 member countries, HQ in Kathmandu)
☛ SAFTA - 2006 (South Asian Free Trade Agreement)
☛ BIMSTEC - 1997 (Includes Bangladesh, India, Myanmar, Sri Lanka, Thailand)
☛ ASEAN - 1967 (Association of Southeast Asian Nations)
☛ SCO - 2001 (Shanghai Cooperation Organization, led by China and Russia)
question_hi:
1987 में, दक्षिण एशियाई क्षेत्रीय सहयोग संघ (SAARC) का सचिवालय _______ में स्थापित किया गया था।

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options_hi: काठमांडू
नई दिल्ली
इस्लामाबाद
ढाका
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है काठमांडू

Explanation:
दक्षिण एशियाई क्षेत्रीय सहयोग संघ (SAARC) का सचिवालय 1987 में काठमांडू, नेपाल में स्थापित किया गया था। SAARC की स्थापना 8 दिसंबर 1985 को हुई थी, और इसका मुख्यालय काठमांडू में होने का निर्णय इसके संस्थापक सदस्य देशों द्वारा लिया गया था। यह सचिवालय संगठन के दैनिक कार्यों और क्षेत्रीय सहयोग को बढ़ावा देने के लिए जिम्मेदार है। काठमांडू को इसलिए चुना गया क्योंकि यह दक्षिण एशिया का एक केंद्रीय और तटस्थ स्थान है, जो सभी सदस्य देशों के लिए सुगम है।

Extra Facts:
SAARC में वर्तमान में 8 सदस्य देश हैं: भारत, पाकिस्तान, बांग्लादेश, नेपाल, श्रीलंका, भूटान, मालदीव और अफगानिस्तान। इसका प्राथमिक उद्देश्य दक्षिण एशिया में आर्थिक, सामाजिक और सांस्कृतिक विकास को बढ़ावा देना है। SAARC ने दक्षिण एशियाई मुक्त व्यापार क्षेत्र (SAFTA) जैसी महत्वपूर्ण पहलें भी शुरू की हैं।

Important Points:
☛ SAARC - 1985 (8 सदस्य देश, काठमांडू में मुख्यालय)
☛ SAFTA - 2006 (दक्षिण एशियाई मुक्त व्यापार समझौता)
☛ BIMSTEC - 1997 (बांग्लादेश, भारत, म्यांमार, श्रीलंका, थाईलैंड सहित 7 सदस्य)
☛ ASEAN - 1967 (दक्षिण-पूर्व एशियाई देशों का संगठन)
☛ SCO - 2001 (शंघाई सहयोग संगठन, चीन और रूस प्रमुख सदस्य)

question:
Which of the following SAARC Centre is established in India?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: SAARC Cultural Centre (SCC)
SAARC Energy Centre (SEC)
SAARC Agriculture Centre (SAC)
SAARC Disaster Management Centre (SDMC)
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is SAARC Disaster Management Centre (SDMC)

Explanation:
The SAARC Disaster Management Centre (SDMC) is established in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India. This center promotes cooperation and capacity building in disaster management among SAARC countries. It was established in 2006 as part of SAARC's 'Disaster Management Framework'. India played a leading role in its establishment, as South Asia is a disaster-prone region. Among the other options, the SAARC Cultural Centre (SCC) is in Sri Lanka, the SAARC Energy Centre (SEC) is in Pakistan, and the SAARC Agriculture Centre (SAC) is in Bangladesh.

Extra Facts:
SAARC (South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation) was founded in 1985. It has 8 member countries: India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Bhutan, Maldives, and Afghanistan. SAARC's headquarters is in Kathmandu, Nepal. The SDMC primarily aims to strengthen regional cooperation in disaster risk reduction, response, and rehabilitation. It conducts training, research, and awareness programs.

Important Points:
☛ SAARC - 1985 (HQ: Kathmandu, Nepal)
☛ SCC - 2009 (Sri Lanka, coordinates cultural activities)
☛ SEC - 2006 (Pakistan, promotes energy cooperation)
☛ SAC - 1988 (Bangladesh, focuses on agricultural research)
☛ SDMC - 2006 (India, specialized in disaster management)
question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सार्क केंद्र भारत में स्थापित है?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options_hi: SAARC सांस्कृतिक केंद्र(SCC)
SAARC ऊर्जा केंद्र(SEC)
SAARC कृषि केंद्र (SAC)
SAARC आपदा प्रबंधन केंद्र(SDMC)
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है SAARC आपदा प्रबंधन केंद्र (SDMC)

Explanation:
SAARC आपदा प्रबंधन केंद्र (SDMC) भारत के गांधीनगर, गुजरात में स्थापित है। यह केंद्र SAARC देशों में आपदा प्रबंधन के लिए सहयोग और क्षमता निर्माण को बढ़ावा देता है। इसकी स्थापना 2006 में हुई थी और यह SAARC के 'आपदा प्रबंधन ढांचे' का हिस्सा है। भारत ने इस केंद्र की स्थापना में अग्रणी भूमिका निभाई, क्योंकि दक्षिण एशिया आपदा-प्रवण क्षेत्र है। अन्य विकल्पों में से SAARC सांस्कृतिक केंद्र (SCC) श्रीलंका, SAARC ऊर्जा केंद्र (SEC) पाकिस्तान और SAARC कृषि केंद्र (SAC) बांग्लादेश में स्थित हैं।

Extra Facts:
SAARC (दक्षिण एशियाई क्षेत्रीय सहयोग संगठन) की स्थापना 1985 में हुई थी। इसके 8 सदस्य देश हैं: भारत, पाकिस्तान, बांग्लादेश, श्रीलंका, नेपाल, भूटान, मालदीव और अफगानिस्तान। SAARC का मुख्यालय काठमांडू, नेपाल में है। SDMC का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य आपदा जोखिम न्यूनीकरण, प्रतिक्रिया और पुनर्वास में क्षेत्रीय सहयोग को मजबूत करना है। यह केंद्र प्रशिक्षण, शोध और जागरूकता कार्यक्रम आयोजित करता है।

Important Points:
☛ SAARC - 1985 (मुख्यालय: काठमांडू, नेपाल)
☛ SCC - 2009 (श्रीलंका, सांस्कृतिक गतिविधियों का समन्वय)
☛ SEC - 2006 (पाकिस्तान, ऊर्जा सहयोग को बढ़ावा)
☛ SAC - 1988 (बांग्लादेश, कृषि अनुसंधान और विकास)
☛ SDMC - 2006 (भारत, आपदा प्रबंधन पर केंद्रित)

question:
Which country is a NOT member of the ‘SAARC’ ?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Iran
Pakistan
India
Bhutan
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Iran

Explanation:
SAARC (South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation) is a regional organization comprising 8 South Asian countries. Its member countries are: India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nepal, Bhutan, Sri Lanka, Maldives, and Afghanistan. Iran is not part of South Asia but is located in the Middle East, hence it is not a member of SAARC. The primary objective of SAARC is to promote economic, social, and cultural cooperation among South Asian nations.

Extra Facts:
SAARC was founded on 8 December 1985, and its headquarters is in Kathmandu, Nepal. The organization has implemented key agreements like SAFTA (South Asian Free Trade Area), aimed at reducing trade barriers among member states. However, due to political differences, SAARC's progress has been slow.

Important Points:
☛ SAARC - 1985 (Kathmandu, Nepal)
☛ SAFTA - 2006 (South Asian Free Trade Area)

☛ SCO - 2001 (Shanghai Cooperation Organization, China-centric)

पाकिस्तान
भारत
भूटान

Extra Facts:
SAARC की स्थापना 8 दिसंबर 1985 को हुई थी और इसका मुख्यालय काठमांडू, नेपाल में है। संगठन ने SAFTA (South Asian Free Trade Area) जैसे महत्वपूर्ण समझौतों को लागू किया है, जिसका उद्देश्य सदस्य देशों के बीच व्यापार बाधाओं को कम करना है। हालांकि, राजनीतिक मतभेदों के कारण SAARC की प्रगति धीमी रही है।

Important Points:
☛ SAARC - 1985 (काठमांडू, नेपाल)
☛ SAFTA - 2006 (दक्षिण एशियाई मुक्त व्यापार क्षेत्र)

☛ ASEAN - 1967 (दक्षिण पूर्व एशियाई देशों का संगठन)
☛ SCO - 2001 (शंघाई सहयोग संगठन, चीन-केंद्रित)

question:
Who was the secretary of UNO between the year 1997-2006?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Trygve Lie
Ban Ki- Moon
Kofi Annan
U- Thant
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Kofi Annan

Explanation:
Kofi Annan was the seventh Secretary-General of the United Nations (UNO) and served from 1 January 1997 to 31 December 2006. He was from Ghana and was the first African Secretary-General to be elected from within the UN staff. He was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 2001. During his tenure, the UN played a significant role in addressing issues like AIDS, terrorism, and human rights.

Extra Facts:
Kofi Annan initiated the 'Global Compact', an international initiative to promote corporate social responsibility. He also played a key role in implementing the Millennium Development Goals (MDGs). His tenure faced challenges like the Iraq War (2003) and the Darfur crisis. Annan emphasized UN reforms during his leadership.

Important Points:
☛ Trygve Lie - 1946-1952 (First UN Secretary-General, Norway)
☛ U Thant - 1961-1971 (Third Secretary-General from Myanmar, served both as acting and appointed)
☛ Ban Ki-moon - 2007-2016 (Eighth Secretary-General from South Korea)
☛ António Guterres - 2017-Present (Ninth Secretary-General from Portugal)
☛ Boutros Boutros-Ghali - 1992-1996 (Sixth Secretary-General from Egypt)
question_hi:
वर्ष 1997-2006 के बीच UNO के सचिव कौन थे?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options_hi: ट्रीगवी ली
बान की मून
कोफ़ी अन्नान
यू- थांट
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है कोफ़ी अन्नान

Explanation:
कोफ़ी अन्नान संयुक्त राष्ट्र संघ (UNO) के सातवें महासचिव थे और उन्होंने 1 जनवरी 1997 से 31 दिसंबर 2006 तक इस पद पर कार्य किया। वह घाना से थे और संयुक्त राष्ट्र के इतिहास में पहले अफ्रीकी महासचिव थे जिन्हें संगठन के कर्मचारियों के बीच से चुना गया था। उन्हें 2001 में नोबेल शांति पुरस्कार भी मिला था। उनके कार्यकाल में एड्स, आतंकवाद और मानवाधिकारों जैसे मुद्दों पर संयुक्त राष्ट्र ने महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई।

Extra Facts:
कोफ़ी अन्नान ने 'ग्लोबल कॉम्पैक्ट' की शुरुआत की, जो कॉर्पोरेट सामाजिक उत्तरदायित्व को बढ़ावा देने वाला एक अंतरराष्ट्रीय पहल था। उन्होंने मिलेनियम डेवलपमेंट गोल्स (MDGs) को लागू करने में भी अहम भूमिका निभाई। उनके कार्यकाल में इराक युद्ध (2003) और दार्फुर संकट जैसी चुनौतियों का सामना करना पड़ा। अन्नान ने संयुक्त राष्ट्र सुधारों पर भी जोर दिया।

Important Points:
☛ ट्रीगवी ली - 1946-1952 (संयुक्त राष्ट्र के पहले महासचिव, नॉर्वे)
☛ यू-थांट - 1961-1971 (म्यांमार से तीसरे महासचिव, कार्यवाहक और नियुक्त दोनों भूमिकाओं में)
☛ बान की मून - 2007-2016 (दक्षिण कोरिया से आठवें महासचिव)
☛ एंटोनियो गुटेरेस - 2017-वर्तमान (पुर्तगाल से नौवें महासचिव)
☛ बुट्रस घाली - 1992-1996 (मिस्र से छठे महासचिव)

question:
Which of the following countries is NOT a permanent member of the United Nations Security Council?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: France
United Kingdom
Japan
China
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is [Japan]

Explanation:
The United Nations Security Council (UNSC) has 5 permanent members: France, United Kingdom, China, Russia, and the United States. Japan is not a permanent member of the UNSC, although it has been elected as a non-permanent member several times. Permanent members have the power of veto, which they can use to block any resolution. This structure was established after World War II, granting special privileges to the victorious powers.

Extra Facts:
The UNSC was established in 1945 and is the most powerful body of the United Nations. It consists of 15 members, out of which 10 are non-permanent and elected for 2-year terms. The primary role of the UNSC is to maintain international peace and security. Until 1971, Taiwan (representing China) was a permanent member, but it was later replaced.

Important Points:
☛ UNSC - 1945 (United Nations Security Council, New York)
☛ Permanent Members: France, UK, China, Russia, USA (with veto power)
☛ Non-Permanent Members: 10 countries, elected for 2-year terms
☛ G4 Nations: Japan, Germany, India, Brazil (aspiring for permanent membership)
☛ Primary Objective of UNSC: Ensure international peace and security
question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा देश संयुक्त राष्ट्र सुरक्षा परिषद का स्थायी सदस्य नहीं है?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options_hi: फ्रांस
यूनाइटीड किंगडम
जापान
चीन
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है [जापान]

Explanation:
संयुक्त राष्ट्र सुरक्षा परिषद (UNSC) के 5 स्थायी सदस्य हैं: फ्रांस, यूनाइटेड किंगडम, चीन, रूस और संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका। जापान UNSC का स्थायी सदस्य नहीं है, हालांकि यह कई बार अस्थायी सदस्य के रूप में चुना गया है। स्थायी सदस्यों को वीटो पावर का अधिकार प्राप्त है, जिसका उपयोग वे किसी भी प्रस्ताव को रोकने के लिए कर सकते हैं। यह व्यवस्था द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध के बाद की गई थी, जब विजयी महाशक्तियों को यह विशेषाधिकार दिया गया था।

Extra Facts:
UNSC की स्थापना 1945 में हुई थी और यह संयुक्त राष्ट्र का सबसे शक्तिशाली अंग है। इसके 15 सदस्य होते हैं, जिनमें से 10 अस्थायी होते हैं और उन्हें 2 साल के लिए चुना जाता है। UNSC का मुख्य कार्य अंतर्राष्ट्रीय शांति और सुरक्षा बनाए रखना है। स्थायी सदस्यों की सूची में 1971 तक ताइवान (चीन का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हुए) शामिल था, लेकिन बाद में इसे बदल दिया गया।

Important Points:
☛ UNSC - 1945 (संयुक्त राष्ट्र सुरक्षा परिषद, न्यूयॉर्क)
☛ स्थायी सदस्य: फ्रांस, यूके, चीन, रूस, USA (वीटो पावर के साथ)
☛ अस्थायी सदस्य: 10 देश, 2 साल के लिए चुने जाते हैं
☛ G4 देश: जापान, जर्मनी, भारत, ब्राजील (स्थायी सदस्यता के लिए दावेदार)
☛ UNSC का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय शांति और सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करना

question:
Which of the following is an Indian ‘not for profit’ organisation, working on sustainable solutions to make sanitation and water accessible to all?

[SSC CGL 2021]
options:
Pratham

Helpage India

Goonj

Sulabh International
solution:
Correct Answer is Option 4, i.e., Sulabh International

Sulabh International is a well-known Indian non-profit organisation founded in 1970 by Dr. Bindeshwar Pathak. It works on sustainable sanitation solutions such as low-cost Sulabh toilets and campaigns to eliminate manual scavenging. The organisation also contributes to providing safe drinking water, human rights awareness, and environmental conservation. Its model has been recognised globally, including by the United Nations, for promoting sanitation in rural and urban India.

question:
Generally in which month does the United Nations call its full General Assembly every year?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: September
June
March
January
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is September

Explanation:
The United Nations (UN) General Assembly is held every year in September. The General Assembly is the main deliberative body of the UN, where all 193 member states participate. It takes place at the UN Headquarters in New York. The session usually begins on the third Tuesday of September and lasts until December. It serves as a key platform for discussing critical global issues such as international peace, security, development, and human rights.

Extra Facts:
The UN General Assembly was established in 1945 and is one of the six principal organs of the UN. The head of the General Assembly is called the President, who is elected annually. The speeches by world leaders during the Assembly are known as the 'General Debate', typically held in the last week of September. This event is a significant opportunity for international cooperation and diplomacy.

Important Points:
☛ UNGA - 1945 (United Nations General Assembly, New York)
☛ UNSC - 1945 (United Nations Security Council, New York)
☛ ICJ - 1945 (International Court of Justice, The Hague)
☛ WHO - 1948 (World Health Organization, Geneva)
☛ UNESCO - 1945 (United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization, Paris)
question_hi:
सामान्यतः संयुक्त राष्ट्र प्रत्येक वर्ष किस माह में अपनी पूर्ण महासभा बुलाता है?

जून
मार्च
जनवरी

Explanation:
संयुक्त राष्ट्र (UN) की पूर्ण महासभा (General Assembly) प्रतिवर्ष सितंबर महीने में आयोजित की जाती है। यह महासभा संयुक्त राष्ट्र का सबसे बड़ा निर्णय लेने वाला अंग है, जिसमें सभी 193 सदस्य देशों के प्रतिनिधि शामिल होते हैं। इसका आयोजन न्यूयॉर्क स्थित संयुक्त राष्ट्र मुख्यालय में किया जाता है। महासभा का यह सत्र आमतौर पर सितंबर के तीसरे मंगलवार से शुरू होता है और दिसंबर तक चलता है। यह अंतरराष्ट्रीय शांति, सुरक्षा, विकास और मानवाधिकार जैसे महत्वपूर्ण मुद्दों पर चर्चा करने का प्रमुख मंच है।

Extra Facts:
संयुक्त राष्ट्र महासभा की स्थापना 1945 में हुई थी। यह संयुक्त राष्ट्र के छह प्रमुख अंगों में से एक है। महासभा के प्रमुख को अध्यक्ष (President) कहा जाता है, जिसे प्रतिवर्ष चुना जाता है। महासभा के दौरान विश्व नेताओं के भाषणों को 'जनरल डिबेट' कहा जाता है, जो आमतौर पर सितंबर के अंतिम सप्ताह में आयोजित होता है। यह अंतरराष्ट्रीय सहयोग और कूटनीति का एक महत्वपूर्ण अवसर होता है।

question:
Where is the headquarters of the International Committee of the Red Cross situated?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: Prague
Geneva
New Delhi
New York
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Geneva

Explanation:
The International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland. Established in 1863, the ICRC is a neutral and impartial humanitarian organization that provides assistance to victims of armed conflicts and other violent situations. Geneva was chosen as its headquarters because Switzerland is a neutral country, making it easier to operate internationally. The ICRC plays a crucial role in implementing the Geneva Conventions and ensuring the protection of war victims.

Extra Facts:
The ICRC has been awarded the Nobel Peace Prize three times (1917, 1944, 1963). It operates in over 100 countries worldwide, focusing on protecting the lives and dignity of victims of war and violence. The organization also works closely with national Red Cross and Red Crescent societies to deliver humanitarian aid.

नई दिल्ली
न्यूयॉर्क
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है जिनेवा

Explanation:
रेड क्रॉस की अंतर्राष्ट्रीय समिति (ICRC) का मुख्यालय जिनेवा, स्विट्जरलैंड में स्थित है। यह संगठन 1863 में स्थापित किया गया था और यह मानवीय संकटों के दौरान पीड़ितों की सहायता के लिए काम करता है। ICRC एक निष्पक्ष, तटस्थ और स्वतंत्र संगठन है जो युद्ध और अन्य हिंसक संघर्षों के दौरान मानवीय सहायता प्रदान करता है। जिनेवा में इसका मुख्यालय होने का कारण यह है कि स्विट्जरलैंड एक तटस्थ देश है और यहां से अंतर्राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर काम करना आसान होता है।

Extra Facts:
ICRC को तीन बार नोबेल शांति पुरस्कार (1917, 1944, 1963) से सम्मानित किया जा चुका है। यह संगठन जिनेवा कन्वेंशन के कार्यान्वयन में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है। ICRC का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य युद्ध और हिंसा के शिकार लोगों की जान बचाना और उनकी गरिमा की रक्षा करना है। यह संगठन दुनिया भर में 100 से अधिक देशों में सक्रिय है।

question:
In which city is the headquarters of the International Rice Research Institute located ?

[RRB NTPC CBT]

New York

Rome

Explanation:
The International Rice Research Institute (IRRI) is headquartered in Los Banos, Philippines. Established in 1960, IRRI is a premier international organization dedicated to rice research. Its mission is to increase rice productivity, improve farmers' income, and ensure environmental sustainability. IRRI played a pivotal role in the Green Revolution by developing high-yielding rice varieties.

Extra Facts:
IRRI has developed advanced rice varieties like Golden Rice, which addresses Vitamin-A deficiency. It is part of the CGIAR (Consultative Group on International Agricultural Research) and operates one of its 17 global research centers. question:
IMF and World Bank were formed in 1944. In which city is their headquarters located?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: New York
Geneva
Washington DC
Vienna
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Washington DC

Explanation:
The headquarters of both the IMF (International Monetary Fund) and the World Bank are located in Washington DC, USA. These institutions were established in 1944 as a result of the Bretton Woods Conference. Their primary objectives are to promote global economic stability and development. The IMF focuses on monetary cooperation and financial stability, while the World Bank provides financial and technical assistance to developing countries.

Extra Facts:
Both the IMF and the World Bank are specialized agencies of the United Nations, but they operate independently. The IMF primarily helps member countries deal with foreign exchange crises, while the World Bank Group consists of five institutions, including the IBRD and IDA. The decision-making process in these institutions is based on voting rights that reflect the economic power of member countries.

☛ IMF - 1944 (International Monetary Fund, Washington DC)

☛ IBRD - 1945 (International Bank for Reconstruction and Development)
☛ IDA - 1960 (International Development Association)

question:
________ is the oldest Trade Union Organisations in India.

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: CITU
AITUC
BMS
INTUC

Solution: Correct Answer is AITUC

Explanation:
The All India Trade Union Congress (AITUC) is the oldest trade union organization in India, established in 1920. It was founded by leaders like Lala Lajpat Rai, Joseph Baptista, and Diwan Chaman Lal. AITUC played a significant role in India's independence movement. The organization is inspired by socialist ideology and fights for minimum wages, better working conditions, and social security for workers. AITUC remains one of India's major trade unions, with over 10 million members.

question:
In the UN Security Council there are:

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: 10 permanent and 5 non-permanent members
10 permanent and 10 non-permanent members
5 permanent and 5 non-permanent members
5 permanent and 10 non-permanent members
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 5 permanent and 10 non-permanent members

Explanation:
The United Nations Security Council (UNSC) consists of 15 members, including 5 permanent members (China, France, Russia, UK, USA) and 10 non-permanent members. The non-permanent members are elected by the UN General Assembly for 2-year terms. The permanent members hold veto power, allowing them to block any substantive resolution. This structure was established in 1945 during the formation of the UN.

Extra Facts:
The primary objective of the UNSC is to maintain international peace and security. It employs measures such as military action, economic sanctions, and peacekeeping missions. The veto power of permanent members is often controversial, as it allows a single country to halt critical decisions.

Important Points:

☛ UNGA - 1945 (United Nations General Assembly, New York)
☛ G4 Nations - India, Japan, Germany, Brazil (Group advocating UNSC reforms)

☛ UNSC non-permanent members' term - 2 years

question:
Which UN body directly deals with the reproductive health of the population?

Explanation:
UNFPA (United Nations Population Fund) is the UN body directly responsible for population and reproductive health. Established in 1969, it works to ensure reproductive health and rights for women, men, and youth. UNFPA focuses on promoting safe pregnancy and childbirth, sexual education, and family planning services. It particularly emphasizes providing these services in developing countries.

Extra Facts:
UNFPA stands for United Nations Population Fund, though it was previously known as the United Nations Fund for Population Activities. UNIDO became an independent specialized agency of the UN in 1985, but the resolution for its establishment was passed in 1966. It assists developing countries and economies in industrialization.

UNIDO is headquartered in Vienna, Austria. Its primary objective is to promote Inclusive and Sustainable Industrial Development (ISID). question:

The report uses the Human Development Index (HDI) to measure countries' development, which is based on factors like education, health, and income. UNDP's primary objectives include poverty eradication, reducing inequality, and promoting sustainable development.

The Human Development Report is published annually and includes HDI rankings of various countries. In the 2020 report, Norway topped the list, while India ranked 131st. These countries were the victors of World War II and have been permanent members since the establishment of the UNSC in 1945. China is the only Asian permanent member of the UNSC. These members have veto power, allowing them to block any resolution. Other options like Japan, Canada, and India can be non-permanent members of the UNSC but are not permanent members.

The primary objective of the UNSC is to maintain international peace and security. It has 15 members, of which 10 are non-permanent (elected for 2-year terms) and 5 are permanent. China replaced Taiwan in 1971. The UNSC has the power to enforce its resolutions and can decide to deploy peacekeeping forces.

Its primary objective is to provide financial and technical assistance to developing countries. The World Bank Group comprises five institutions, including the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) and the International Development Association (IDA). It is also a specialized agency of the United Nations.

Extra Facts:
The World Bank was initially created to aid in the reconstruction of Europe after World War II but later shifted its focus to global poverty reduction and sustainable development. It works closely with the International Monetary Fund (IMF), and both are headquartered in Washington DC. The World Bank's annual reports and Ease of Doing Business rankings are widely recognized.

question:
The World Food Program (WFP) is the food assistance branch of the United Nations. Where is it headquartered?

[SSC CGL 2019]
options: Rome
Paris
New York
Brussels
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Rome

Explanation:
The World Food Programme (WFP) is the primary food assistance branch of the United Nations, established in 1961. Its headquarters is located in Rome, Italy. The primary objective of WFP is to eradicate hunger and food insecurity worldwide. It provides emergency food assistance in crisis-affected areas and supports long-term development projects. The reason for its headquarters being in Rome is that other major UN food and agriculture organizations like the FAO (Food and Agriculture Organization) and IFAD (International Fund for Agricultural Development) are also headquartered there, facilitating better coordination.

Extra Facts:
The WFP was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 2020 in recognition of its relentless efforts in conflict and climate-affected regions. The organization reaches approximately 100 million people annually with food assistance. WFP's activities include school meal programs, cash transfers, and agricultural development projects. It relies entirely on voluntary funding, with major donors including the USA, EU, and Germany.

Important Points:
☛ WFP - 1961 (Headquarters: Rome, Italy)
☛ FAO - 1945 (Headquarters: Rome, Italy)
☛ IFAD - 1977 (Headquarters: Rome, Italy)
☛ UNICEF - 1946 (Headquarters: New York, USA)
☛ WHO - 1948 (Headquarters: Geneva, Switzerland)

question:
What is the name of the intergovernmental military alliance between 30 European and North American countries?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: The International Military Fund
The World Militia Organization
The International Military Collaboration
The North Atlantic Treaty Organization
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is The North Atlantic Treaty Organization

Explanation:
The North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) is an intergovernmental military alliance established on 4 April 1949. It is a collective security organization comprising 30 European and North American countries, with the primary objective of ensuring the security and stability of its member states. NATO is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium. The organization operates on the principle of 'collective defense', where an attack on one member is considered an attack on all (Article 5). It was founded during the Cold War to counter Soviet expansion.

Extra Facts:
NATO stands for North Atlantic Treaty Organization. Its member countries include the USA, Canada, the UK, France, Germany, etc. NATO has played a key role in conflicts like Kosovo, Afghanistan, and Libya. In 2020, North Macedonia became NATO's 30th member. NATO's military wing is the Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe (SHAPE), located in Mons, Belgium.

Important Points:
☛ NATO - 1949 (30 members, Brussels, Belgium)
☛ Warsaw Pact - 1955 (Soviet Union's military alliance, dissolved in 1991)
☛ UNSC - 1945 (United Nations Security Council, New York)
☛ SEATO - 1954 (Southeast Asia Treaty Organization, dissolved in 1977)
☛ ANZUS - 1951 (Security treaty between Australia, New Zealand, and the USA)
question_hi:
30 यूरोपीय और उत्तरी अमेरिकी देशों के बीच अंतर सरकारी सैन्य गठबंधन का क्या नाम है?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options_hi: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सैन्य कोष
विश्व मिलिशिया संगठन
अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सैन्य सहयोग

solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है उत्तरी अटलांटिक संधि संगठन

Explanation:
उत्तरी अटलांटिक संधि संगठन (NATO) एक अंतर सरकारी सैन्य गठबंधन है जिसकी स्थापना 4 अप्रैल 1949 को हुई थी। यह 30 यूरोपीय और उत्तरी अमेरिकी देशों का एक सामूहिक सुरक्षा संगठन है, जिसका मुख्य उद्देश्य सदस्य देशों की सुरक्षा और स्थिरता सुनिश्चित करना है। NATO का मुख्यालय ब्रुसेल्स, बेल्जियम में स्थित है। यह संगठन 'सामूहिक रक्षा' के सिद्धांत पर कार्य करता है, जिसके तहत किसी एक सदस्य पर हमला सभी पर हमला माना जाता है (अनुच्छेद 5)। इसकी स्थापना शीत युद्ध के दौरान सोवियत संघ के विस्तार को रोकने के लिए की गई थी।

Extra Facts:
NATO का पूरा नाम North Atlantic Treaty Organization है। इसके सदस्य देशों में अमेरिका, कनाडा, ब्रिटेन, फ्रांस, जर्मनी आदि शामिल हैं। NATO ने कोसोवो, अफगानिस्तान और लीबिया जैसे संघर्षों में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई है। 2020 में उत्तरी मैसेडोनिया NATO का 30वां सदस्य बना। NATO की सैन्य शाखा Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe (SHAPE) है, जो मॉन्स, बेल्जियम में स्थित है।
